Good Morning Julia,

As per your request, please find the 6-month rates for Downtown Views 2 Tower 2

July: AED 8,000
August: AED 14,500
September: AED 16,500
October: AED 19,200
November: AED 20,300
December: AED 23,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

Thank you.
